quote: I enjoyed the session and I came away with some good ideas and tips on how to make my virtual presentation more impactful. Martin is an effective communicator, and the topics/tips that he presented addressed the concerns that I had about myself and my abilities. I also had some tech issues on my side early, but it did not affect my ability to participate, which speaks to his preparedness and accessability of the material.
author: John Hwang
subject: Virtual Presentation Skills
